name: Virtual Life Support
summary:
Virtual Life Support™ isn’t just a training tool; it’s a solution that redefines how we prepare for life-saving moments. By blending technology with proven training methodologies, it empowers individuals to take action when it matters most.

It is a cutting-edge virtual reality (VR) training solution designed to transform the way **CPR** and emergency response skills are taught. By immersing trainees in highly realistic scenarios, it bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world application,
